name: iCarly
description: Ten years after signing off of one of TV's most iconic shows, Carly, Spencer, and Freddie are back, navigating the next chapter of their lives, facing the uncertainties of life in their twenties.

videos.title: The iCarly Reunion
videos.overview: Join Miranda Cosgrove, Jerry Trainor and Nathan Kress to reflect upon and celebrate the iconic original series "iCarly." Plus, meet new members of the family, Laci Mosley and Jaidyn Triplett, in an exclusive look at the series revival.

videos.title: iStart Over
videos.overview: Carly Shay navigates the next chapter of her life, moving past a failed relationship and reinventing her web show. Spencer tries to impress Harper with his art.

videos.title: iHate Carly
videos.overview: Carly finds it refreshing to date a guy who's never seen her show, until she discovers his huge secret. Meanwhile, when Spencer accidentally blinds himself with pepper spray, he enlists Freddie to be his "guide dog."

videos.title: iFauxpologize
videos.overview: A disgusted reaction from Carly is paired with Spencer's latest artwork to become a popular meme, giving Carly new viral fame but leaving Spencer feeling insulted and out for revenge. Millicent finds Freddie's troubling old social media posts, which gives her a brilliant idea.

videos.title: iGot Your Back
videos.overview: After enlisting Harper's help for a red-carpet event, Carly starts to doubt that Harper understands her best interests and questions their friendship. Meanwhile, Spencer goes to extraordinary lengths to get Freddie his first post-divorce date.

videos.title: iRobot Wedding
videos.overview: Carly's nemesis Nevel invites the group to his wedding, but Carly suspects that the bride isn't what she claims to be. Harper and Spencer wager on who can collect the most phone numbers at the wedding.

videos.title: i'M Cursed
videos.overview: Carly makes plans to spend her birthday alone in an attempt to stave off her dreaded birthday curse, but Spencer has different plans. Freddie tries to recapture his youth. Harper's idol leaves her awestruck.

videos.title: iNeed Space
videos.overview: Carly and Harper's search for a better workspace leads them to a private women's club where the leader is charismatic and demanding. Freddie enrolls Millicent in the Sunshine Girls, but she instead mobilizes the kids into workers for her cupcake empire.

videos.title: iLove Gwen
videos.overview: Carly and Millicent push Freddie and his ex-wife together after a series of misunderstandings lead them to believe the couple wants to reunite. Harper and Spencer get roped into doing tech work on Millicent's school play.

videos.title: iMLM
videos.overview: A new powder supplement seems to have instant benefits for the group, but Freddie's devotion to the product puts his future at risk after Carly discovers it's a midlevel marketing scam.

videos.title: iTake a Girls' Trip
videos.overview: Carly's first-ever girl's trip doesn't go as planned when the only other person on the getaway is Freddie. Harper's missing cousin resurfaces, and is instantly smitten with Spencer.

videos.title: iCan Fix It Myself
videos.overview: Carly is in over her head when she tries to repair her car herself rather than ask for help. Spencer tries to help Maeve reveal her secret to Harper.

videos.title: iThrow a Flawless Dinner Party
videos.overview: Carly plans a dinner party to help clear up her relationship status with Wes, but a glitchy app, Harper's work problems, and Spencer's love life intrude on her perfectly planned evening.

videos.title: iReturn to Webicon
videos.overview: Carly and the gang return to Webicon, where they run into a familiar face.

videos.title: iGuess Everyone Just Hates Me Now
videos.overview: After the whole internet turns against Carly, she tries to win her audience back by faking a relationship with Freddie. Spencer gets overzealous planning Freddie's new app launch party, while Harper tries to get Double Dutch's dog to like her.

videos.title: iObject, Lewbert!
videos.overview: Carly must defend herself in court with Spencer and Freddie's help after Lewbert returns seeking damages from injuries sustained on her old web show. Millicent tries to make Harper her new bestie.

videos.title: i'M Wild and Crazy
videos.overview: After a game of Never Have I Ever, Carly fears she is boring and sets out to prove to Harper that she can hold her own on a wild night out on the town. Spencer finds new office space for Freddie's app at the old Groovy Smoothie location.

videos.title: iHire a New Assistant
videos.overview: When Grandad comes to visit, Carly hires him as her assistant, while Spencer is determined to finally win his respect. Harper helps Freddie with his birth chart and is horrified to discover that they are a perfect match.

videos.title: iCupid
videos.overview: Carly hires a matchmaker to help Spencer find someone to settle down with, but when he falls for the matchmaker instead, Carly must convince her that Spencer is her type. Freddie is ready to move out on his own, but it won't be easy.

videos.title: iBuild a Team
videos.overview: Carly hires a manager to take her channel to the next level, but when the new guy butts heads with Freddie, Carly must figure out a way to make her team work. Spencer tries to please a tough food critic.

videos.title: iDragged Him
videos.overview: Carly gets an opportunity to audition for a reality adventure competition show with Spencer as her partner, but his competitive tactics create tension between the siblings. Harper styles a Hollywood Icons drag night while Freddie helps Millicent with her Model UN Tournament.

videos.title: i'M a USA Bae
videos.overview: Carly gets the collab of a lifetime when a USA Bae Doll is to be made in her image. But when the popular “Influencer” doll is nothing like her, Carly must decide what message she wants to send to her fans. Spencer enlists a pet monkey to help Freddie fix his relationship troubles.

videos.title: iHit Something
videos.overview: Humiliated after being the target of a viral prank, Carly finds an outlet for her anger with Harper’s help, leading them both to an underground fight club for influencers. Spencer and Freddie help Millicent with a boy problem.

videos.title: iThrow a Flawless Murder Mystery Party
videos.overview: Carly realizes Freddie’s new girlfriend needs help planning his perfect birthday party, but Carly’s insight into what makes Freddie happy leads to a stunning revelation about their relationship. Spencer and Harper scheme to leave the party early to meet new dates, while Millicent is distracted by her new crush.

videos.title: iBuckled
videos.overview: Carly dives into work to distract herself from Freddie, working with Paul on a sizzle reel for a Carly-centric reality show. But Paul pushes Carly's love triangle to create more drama.

videos.title: iLove Your Shoes
videos.overview: Carly realizes she has feelings for Freddie, but tries to get over him by dating a new guy. An old rival from boarding school hires Harper. After a review calls Spencer out of touch, he tries to prove he's a man of the people.

videos.title: iMake New Memories
videos.overview: Committed to rebuilding their friendship, Carly and Freddie team up to recreate some of their favorite memories after all of Carly’s photos and videos are erased from her phone.

videos.title: iGo Public
videos.overview: Freddie asks Spencer for help creating an elaborate display to announce his relationship with Carly, who is not yet ready to go public with the news.

videos.title: iFaked It
videos.overview: Carly discovers that she is the victim of a Deep Fake, which has the internet convinced that she has endorsed a viral food product that is making Seattle residents sick.

videos.title: iReunited and It Felt Okay
videos.overview: Carly is excited to give the keynote speech at her high school reunion, but a surprise revelation puts her at the mercy of an old classmate.

videos.title: iGo to Toledo
videos.overview: Carly plans a bachelorette party for Mrs. Benson, based around her favourite show, "Toledo House Flip."

videos.title: iCause a Cat-astrophe
videos.overview: After Carly regrets donating an expensive gift from Harper’s girlfriend to a cat charity, she enlists her friends to steal it back.

videos.title: iCreate a New Ecosystem
videos.overview: Carly and Freddie struggle to find the perfect time to tell Millicent's mom about their relationship, fearing that she will take Millicent away with her.

videos.title: iHave a Proposal
videos.overview: It's the Wedding of the Century! Mrs. Benson and Lewbert are getting married, but a misunderstanding leads Freddie and Carly to consider their own future together.
